gui.chrono_bubble.title: Chrono Bubble - Settings
gui.chrono_bubble.reset_done: Page reset to defaults (click Save to keep it).
config.chrono_bubble.limits.max_time.too: Maximum Time. 0 = no limit. Above it the addon clamps the value.
config.chrono_bubble.throw.enabled.toolt: Turns throwing on/off (throwable Chrono Stasis and Time Steal)
config.chrono_bubble.throw.mana_required: Minimum mana (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.throw.time_required: Minimum Time (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.throw.cooldown_tick: Cooldown in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second), shared by both throws
config.chrono_bubble.throw.freeze_second: How long the Chrono Stasis orb freezes its target (seconds)
config.chrono_bubble.steal.mana_required: Minimum mana (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.steal.drain_hp.tool: Maximum health drained per hit (2 = 1 heart)
config.chrono_bubble.steal.punch_fixed_g: Time per regular Time Steal punch (0 = original)
Time gained on each regular Time Steal punch (no Shift). 0 = keep the mod's original behavior (+10, only below 1000).
config.chrono_bubble.steal.time_per_hp.t: Time gained per drained health point
config.chrono_bubble.sustained.max_targe: How many targets at the same time
config.chrono_bubble.sustained.mana_per_: Mana per second FOR EACH target
config.chrono_bubble.sustained.warn_seco: 'Unstable time' warning when this many seconds of mana are left
config.chrono_bubble.sustained.accumulat: true = damage taken by a held target is stored and dealt all at once on release
config.chrono_bubble.grigora.mana_per_se: Mana per second FOR EACH target
config.chrono_bubble.grigora.time_cost.t: Time spent to activate (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.grigora.skip_bosses: true = the Ender Dragon and the Wither are not held
Minimum mana to turn it on (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.zone.own_projectile: true = the owner's own projectiles pass through the zone
config.chrono_bubble.zone.projectile_orb: Draw a Chrono Stasis orb on each projectile stopped by the zone
Extra reach (blocks) to predict and stop very fast projectiles
config.chrono_bubble.precognition.requir: true = only while the combat bar is active
config.chrono_bubble.precognition.horizo: How many ticks ahead to predict (20 = 1 second)
config.chrono_bubble.precognition.warn_m: Also warn about mobs about to attack in melee
config.chrono_bubble.acceleration.mana_t: Minimum mana to turn it on (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.acceleration.max_se: Maximum duration (s, 0 = until mana runs out)
Maximum duration in seconds. 0 = until mana runs out.
config.chrono_bubble.acceleration.cooldo: Cooldown after it ends, in ticks (20 = 1 second)
config.chrono_bubble.acceleration.speed_: Speed effect level (0 = I, 1 = II, 2 = III...)
config.chrono_bubble.acceleration.haste_: Haste effect level, which speeds up attacks (0 = I, 1 = II...)
config.chrono_bubble.acceleration.slow_p: true = other players are slowed too
config.chrono_bubble.hop.enabled.tooltip: true = apply the effects below when you use Time Hop
config.chrono_bubble.hop.fall_immunity_t: How long after the hop falling deals no damage (0 = off, 20 = 1 s)
config.chrono_bubble.hop.protect_ticks.t: Time without damage or knockback on arrival (0 = off)
config.chrono_bubble.hop.pulse_enabled.t: true = on arrival, nearby mobs and projectiles are stopped
config.chrono_bubble.hop.pulse_ticks.too: How long the pulse keeps everything stopped (20 = 1 s)
config.chrono_bubble.hop.pulse_players.t: true = other players are stopped too (PvP)
config.chrono_bubble.hop.pulse_bosses.to: true = the Ender Dragon and the Wither are stopped too
config.chrono_bubble.hop.trail_enabled.t: true = leave a Chrono Stasis bubble with your skin inside at the starting point
config.chrono_bubble.hop.trail_ticks.too: How long the bubble stays at the starting point (20 = 1 s)
true = the original Time Hop is cancelled and replaced by the dash (the 'effects' above no longer apply)
config.chrono_bubble.hop_rework.time_cos: Time spent per hop (you need MORE than this)
config.chrono_bubble.hop_rework.dash_tic: How many ticks the dash to the destination takes
config.chrono_bubble.hop_rework.linger_t: How long time stays stopped after you arrive
config.chrono_bubble.hop_rework.freeze_e: true = mobs near the path are frozen during the hop
config.chrono_bubble.hop_rework.freeze_p: true = other players are frozen too
config.chrono_bubble.hop_rework.skip_bos: true = the Ender Dragon and the Wither are not frozen
config.chrono_bubble.swallowtail.capacit: How much Time it can store
config.chrono_bubble.rebirth.unlock_time: Time needed for the powers and the grimoire to come back
config.chrono_bubble.rebirth.block_passi: true = no passive Time regeneration until unlocked
config.chrono_bubble.visual.show_time_ga: Show rising Roman numerals when Time is stolen
config.chrono_bubble.visual.time_gain_mi: Minimum Time gained in one tick to show
config.chrono_bubble.visual.hide_stasis_: Hide the cyan Chrono Stasis/Grigora particles (needs a game restart)
config.chrono_bubble.visual.sphere_scale: Size of the spheres around frozen mobs (multiplier)
msg.chrono_bubble.status_no_block_clover: Block Clover not found (or incompatible version): check the server log.
gui.chrono_bubble.readonly_menu: Open a world to change the server rules.

advancements.chrono_bubble.full_swallowt: Fill a Swallowtail to its maximum capacity

advancements.chrono_bubble.rebirth.descr: Be reborn using the Time stored in a Swallowtail
msg.chrono_bubble.hop_no_space: No room to hop in that direction.
config.chrono_bubble.precognition.requir: true = only works with Block Clover's Time Magic Zone passive unlocked and active (it is the one that 'senses future attacks')
config.chrono_bubble.rebirth.time_ressur: true = on a killing blow, the Time Ressurection passive acts first if it is ready (full charge and more than 300 Time; consumes all Time) and the Swallowtail is left untouched. If it is not ready, the Swallowtail rebirth applies.
msg.chrono_bubble.ressurection_saved: Time Ressurection consumed all your Time and saved you from the killing blow. The Swallowtail was not used.
